blocks.p: ABOUT

Social work in an emerging world. The conference brings together practitioners, educators, researchers, students and people with lived experience of services to examine how social work is changing, and what must not change.
Across two days on the IHM North Melbourne Campus, the program spans practice, education, research and innovation — with deliberate space for students and early-career practitioners.

Practitioners, team leaders and managers · field educators and supervisors · academics and researchers · social work students · agency and industry leaders · Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander practitioners and organisations · people with lived experience · IHM faculty, research team, leadership and Board.

ul: A keynote address on each day
Parallel sessions across ten practice and research streams
Posters displayed across both days, with staffed sessions
Conference proceedings published after the event

blocks.p: ABSTRACTS OPEN 14 SEPTEMBER 2026
The call for abstracts opens Monday 14 September 2026. Register your interest now to receive it directly.
Abstracts for conference papers and posters are invited from:

ul: IHM Bachelor of Social Work students
Social work students and academics from other universities
Peer review by two reviewers, with written feedback
Presentation to an audience of practitioners, educators and students
Optional inclusion in the conference proceedings
Direct contact with agencies, employers and placement providers
Oral presentation — 15 minutes plus 5 for questions
Poster — displayed both days, staffed session

blocks.p: Submit an abstract for either format. Abstracts are reviewed by the Scientific Committee, and selected authors are invited to present.

faq: A poster is a single printed display of your work — prepared on computer and printed for display — setting out your research, practice initiative or project on one page. Posters are displayed across both days with a staffed session and require an abstract in the same way as an oral presentation. They suit work in progress and are the most accessible starting point for a first presentation.
A conference proceeding will be published after the conference. Publication is optional.
Abstract guidelines, word limits and the submission link will be circulated when the call opens on Monday 14 September 2026. Contact the Scientific Committee Coordinator for early enquiries.

blocks.p: KEY DATES
REGISTRATION
IHM students and staff attend complimentary. A registration fee applies to all other participants and will be announced with the program. Early-bird rates close Friday 6 November 2026.

cards: Certificates of attendance issued to all delegates. Step-free access, a quiet room, and dietary requirements catered as standard. Tell us your access requirements when you register.
IHM North Melbourne Campus. Full venue, transport and parking details will be circulated with the program on Friday 30 October 2026.
Sponsorship and exhibition opportunities are available. Contact the organising committee to discuss.

blocks.p: CONTACTS
All conference enquiries go to [swconference2026@ihm.edu.au](mailto:swconference2026@ihm.edu.au).
